players.product: biosimulation, regulatory science, and AI-assisted drug-development software

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K fiscal 2025 results: total revenues were $418,838 thousand, up 9% from $385,148 thousand, with organic revenue of $401,825 thousand (+6%) after $17,013 thousand of acquisition-related revenue. Software revenue was $183,275 thousand (+18%) and services revenue $235,563 thousand (+3%); income from operations was $21,016 thousand versus a loss of $1,731 thousand in 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue $418,838 thousand (+9%); organic $401,825 thousand (+6%); software $183,275 thousand (+18%); services $235,563 thousand (+3%)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer base and concentration: Certara's science, technology and consulting services have been used by more than 2,600 biopharmaceutical and biotech companies and academic institutions across 70 countries, including 38 of the top 40 biopharmaceutical companies by R&D spend in 2025; its software is licensed by 20 global drug regulatory agencies including the FDA, EMA, Japan's PMDA, China's CDE and the UK's MHRA. No single customer accounted for more than 10% of revenues in 2025; the ten largest customers accounted for 24% of revenues in 2025 and 27% in 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: ten largest customers 24% of 2025 revenues (27% in 2024); no customer above 10%; 38 of top 40 biopharma; 20 regulatory agencies

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K product description (no contract or figures stated): Phoenix Cloud, Certara's next generation cloud version of Phoenix, provides a secured and validated Certara Amazon Web Services (AWS) workspace allowing much quicker transit time from compliant data sources; it supports compliance requirements by managing complex time-based drug data, the foundation for all PK/PD modeling.
